candidates.review_note: Multiplication of power-of-two edge costs adds their integer exponents. Kruskal minimizes that sum, and a product2^E has exactlyE+1 positive divisors. Bit length extracts exponents exactly.

A counterclockwise convex polygon is the intersection of the left half-planes of its edges. Clip the running polygon against every half-plane using segment-line intersections, then compute its shoelace area; empty intersections producezero.

Operations shorten runs but cannot delete a run entirely. Thus the sequence of run characters is invariant, and a palindrome is possible exactly when that sequence is palindromic; reducing each run to one character proves sufficiency.

Apply inclusion-exclusion to the five divisibility events, using least common multiples for intersections and floor differences for the inclusive interval. This also handles repeated divisors without ad-hoc cases.

Parse the stated expression grammar with recursive descent: atoms, multiplication, then addition. Require complete consumption and balanced parentheses; reject missing operands, implicit multiplication, unsupported operators, and nonnumeric tokens without evaluating arbitrary input.

Each player can win at most floor(total/k) sets. Taking both maxima leaves remainders that must fit as losing scores in the other player wins, each at mostk-1. If either remainder cannot fit even with maximum opposing wins, decreasing wins only worsens feasibility.

A trie captures legal prefixes. Bottom-up normal and reversed terminal outcomes determine whether the starting player can force winning and losing a single game. If both are available the player controls the final game; if only winning is available parity matters.

Simulate synchronous yearly rounds: newly awakened regions cannot help other regions until the next round. Sets avoid duplicate-neighbor counts, and declared region count detects isolated sleeping nodes missing from all edges.

Inclusion-exclusion over empty rows and empty columns leaves binomial((N-i)(M-j),R) placements. Precomputed factorials and modular inverses evaluate all coefficients; impossible covers naturally givezero.
The revenue is sum over i=0..m-1 of floor((n*i+x)/m). Euclidean floor-sum reduction computes it in logarithmic time even when m is10^15; no floating point or per-person loop is used.

Meet in the middle enumerates subset sums grouped by selected count in each half. Choose exactly floor(n/2) coins and binary-search complementary sums nearest half the total, preserving the group-size constraint without value-sizedDP.

TreeDP tracks the exact nearest selected-vertex distance, capped at k+1 for sufficiently far or empty choices. Shift child distances by one; merging is legal precisely when the two nearest distances sum above k. Keep the best weight for each resulting minimum distance.
The promised disjoint non-touching filled rectangles each have exactly one cell with neither a star above nor a star to its left. Count these upper-left corners in one pass.
